cohort: 24,643 women who gave birth at eight referral hospitals in Burkina Faso.
finding: The overall caesarean section rate was 30.6%, with particularly high rates (26.5% and 15%) observed in Robson groups 1 and 3, which also showed low oxytocin use and high stillbirth rates.
mod_finding: The overall caesarean section rate was 30.6%, with high rates in Robson groups 1 and 3 (26.5% and 15% respectively) alongside low oxytocin administration rates (7.9% and 6.5%).
